iti34:1.1: 7 vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatāti me sutaṃ
iti34:2.1: anātāpī bhikkhave bhikkhu anottappī abhabbo sambodhāya abhabbo nibbānāya abhabbo anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya
iti34:2.2: ātāpī kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ottappī bhabbo sambodhāya bhabbo nibbānāya bhabbo anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāyāti.
iti34:5.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
